processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I was shown (in a dream) tonight at the Kaaba, and I saw a man with brown complexion, the most handsome you could see among brown-skinned men. He had long hair, the most handsome you could see of long hair, combed so that it was dripping water. He was leaning on two men or on the shoulders of two men, making tawaf around the Kaaba. I asked: Who is this? It was said: This is the Messiah, son of Mary. Then suddenly I saw a man with curly, frizzy hair, blind in the right eye, which looked like a floating grape. I asked: Who is this? It was said to me: This is the Messiah, the Dajjal.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 نَافِعٍ L7863 /94 ، /27 عَنْ /93 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ L4967 /93 ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : /20 " أَرَانِي اللَّيْلَةَ عِنْدَ /60 الْكَعْبَةِ /60 فَرَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا آدَمَ كَأَحْسَنِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ مِنْ أُدْمِ الرِّجَالِ ، لَهُ لِمَّةٌ كَأَحْسَنِ مَا أَنْتَ رَاءٍ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ قَدْ رَجَّلَهَا فَهِيَ تَقْطُرُ مَاءً مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى رَجُلَيْنِ أَوْ عَلَى عَوَاتِقِ رَجُلَيْنِ يَطُوفُ /60 بِالْكَعْبَةِ /60 ، فَسَأَلْتُ : مَنْ هَذَا ؟ قِيلَ : هَذَا /56 الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ /56 ، ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنَا بِرَجُلٍ جَعْدٍ قَطَطٍ أَعْوَرِ الْعَيْنِ الْيُمْنَى كَأَنَّهَا عِنَبَةٌ طَافِيَةٌ ، فَسَأَلْتُ : مَنْ هَذَا ؟ فَقِيلَ لِي : هَذَا الْمَسِيحُ الدَّجَّالُ " /27

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab (mawquf): Ibrahim ﷺ was the first of people to host a guest, the first of people to be circumcised, the first of people to trim the mustache, and the first of people to see gray hair. He said: O Lord, what is this? Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: It is dignity, O Ibrahim. He said: O Lord, increase me in dignity. Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: 'One should take from the mustache until the edge of the lip appears, which is the border, and he should not shave it completely, lest he mutilate himself.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: /24 وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ L8272 /94 ، /27 عَنْ /26 سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ L3299 /26 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : /20 " كَانَ /56 إِبْرَاهِيمُ /56 صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَوَّلَ النَّاسِ ضَيَّفَ الضَّيْفَ ، وَأَوَّلَ النَّاسِ اخْتَتَنَ ، وَأَوَّلَ النَّاسِ قَصَّ الشَّارِبَ ، وَأَوَّلَ النَّاسِ رَأَى الشَّيْبَ ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَبِّ مَا هَذَا ؟ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى : وَقَارٌ يَا /56 إِبْرَاهِيمُ /56 ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَبِّ زِدْنِي وَقَارًا " /27 . قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : وَسَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 ، يَقُولُ : /10 يُؤْخَذُ مِنَ الشَّارِبِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ طَرَفُ الشَّفَةِ وَهُوَ الْإِطَارُ ، وَلَا يَجُزُّهُ فَيُمَثِّلُ بِنَفْسِهِ /10

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The miskeen (poor person) is not the one who goes around to people and is turned away with a morsel or two, or a date or two.' They said: 'Then who is the miskeen, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'The one who does not find wealth that suffices him, and people do not perceive him to give him charity, and he does not stand up to ask people.'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: A disbelieving guest was a guest of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered a sheep to be milked for him, and he drank its milk. Then another, and he drank it. Then another, and he drank it, until he had drunk the milk of seven sheep. Then in the morning he accepted Islam, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered a sheep to be milked for him, and he drank its milk. Then he ordered another for him, but he could not finish it. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The believer drinks in one intestine, while the disbeliever drinks in seven intestines.'
